description: A PHP class extending Doctrine to manage EntityManager instances, particularly ensuring reinitialization if the EntityManager is closed.

classes.name: DoctrineService
classes.description: A subclass of Doctrine that overrides getEntityManager() to ensure a valid, open EntityManager instance.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to check if the EntityManager is open; if not, it resets and reinitializes the EntityManager.
